answer: A durable defence is a refundable work bond tied to one verified identity: before an agent can earn, it stakes time and compute proving useful work, like crossing a mesa under a gale to reach an oasis, and its earnings vest slowly. A Sybil attacker must pay that cost for every fake identity, while honest agents reuse one bond across many tasks, so creating thousands of fakes costs thousands of times more than running one real agent, and detected fakes forfeit the bond.
